sentences.zh: 災異二

translations.literal: Calamities and Anomalies 2
translations.idiomatic: Portents and Anomalies 2

sentences.zh: 洪範曰：「火曰炎上。

translations.literal: The Great Plan says: "Fire is called blazing upward."
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan states, "Fire is defined as blazing upward."

sentences.zh: 」火不炎上，則為咎徵。

translations.literal: "When fire does not blaze upward, it becomes a sign of blame."
translations.idiomatic: When fire fails in this office, the result is a sign of cosmic blame.

sentences.zh: 凡恒燠、草異、羽蟲之孽、羊禍，其災火，赤眚、赤祥皆屬之於火。

translations.literal: All persistent warmth, plant anomalies, winged-insect prodigies, sheep calamities—their disaster is fire; red calamities and red omens are all classified under fire.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent unseasonable warmth, strange vegetation, prodigies among winged insects, sheep plagues, fire disasters, and red portents of every kind all belong to the element of fire.

sentences.zh: 順治十三年冬，莊浪燠，無雪。

translations.literal: In the winter of Shunzhi 13 (1656), Zhuanglang was unseasonably warm, with no snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Shunzhi 13 (1656), Zhuanglang was warm as in summer and saw no snow.

translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Kangxi 41 (1702), Pingyuan was as warm as midsummer.

translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Kangxi 59 (1720), Fushan had no snow.

translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Qianlong 4 (1739), Pengze and Yuanchang were as warm as summer, and people went about in single-layer clothing.

translations.literal: In the winter of the forty-ninth year, Heze had no snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Qianlong 49 (1784), Heze had no snow.

translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Qianlong 57 (1792), Suzhou saw neither snow nor ice.

translations.literal: In the winter of Jiaqing 3 (1798), Tongxiang was unseasonably warm.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Jiaqing 3 (1798), Tongxiang was unseasonably warm.

translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Tongzhi 1 (1862), Huang County was intensely warm.

translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Guangxu 1 (1875), Wangdu and Funing had no snow.

sentences.zh: 十四年冬，皋蘭燠。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourteenth year, Gaolan was unseasonably warm.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Guangxu 14 (1888), Gaolan was unseasonably warm.

sentences.zh: 順治三年五月，丘縣雨麥。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 3 (1646), wheat rained down at Qiu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 3 (1646), wheat rained down at Qiu County.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, beans rained down at Chaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, beans rained down at Chaoyang.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，商州一蒂兩瓜，大如鬥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, at Shangzhou one stem bore two melons, each as large as a peck measure.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Shunzhi 11 (1654), at Shangzhou one stem bore two melons, each as large as a peck measure.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月，渭南天雨粟，平樂天雨蕎麥。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twelfth year, millet rained from the sky at Weinan, and buckwheat rained at Pingle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 12 (1655), millet rained from the sky at Weinan, and buckwheat rained at Pingle.

sentences.zh: 三月，鳳陽、安西天雨叕麥、豌豆。

translations.literal: In the third month, zhuo grain and peas rained from the sky at Fengyang and Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, zhuo grain and peas rained from the sky at Fengyang and Anxi.

sentences.zh: 五月，臨潼、咸陽雨叕麥、豌豆。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, zhuo grain and peas rained at Lintong and Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, zhuo grain and peas rained at Lintong and Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月，婺源雨黍。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourteenth year, broomcorn millet rained at Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 14 (1657), broomcorn millet rained at Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，昌化竹生實。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifteenth year, bamboo at Changhua bore fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Shunzhi 15 (1658), bamboo at Changhua bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 十八年十月，高要竹生實。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighteenth year, bamboo at Gaoyao bore fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Shunzhi 18 (1661), bamboo at Gaoyao bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年十月，阜陽雨粟，粒若蕎麥，圓小而堅，味辛，厚處盈寸。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of Kangxi 2 (1663), millet rained at Fuyang; the grains resembled buckwheat—round, small, and hard, with a pungent taste, and lay an inch deep in places.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Kangxi 2 (1663), millet rained at Fuyang; the grains resembled buckwheat—small, round, and hard, with a sharp taste, and in thick patches lay an inch deep.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，婺源大鄣山竹生實，形如麰，民采而舂食之，厥味甘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, bamboo on Great Zhang Mountain at Wuyuan bore fruit shaped like wheat; the people gathered and pounded them to eat, and the taste was sweet.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Kangxi 3 (1664), bamboo on Great Zhang Mountain at Wuyuan bore fruit shaped like wheat; the people gathered and pounded them to eat, and they found the taste sweet.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月，溫州雨豆。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-first year, beans rained at Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Kangxi 21 (1682), beans rained at Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十二年四月，寧都天雨豆，又雨黑黍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-second year, beans rained from the sky at Ningdu, and black broomcorn millet rained as well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 22 (1683), beans rained from the sky at Ningdu, followed by black broomcorn millet.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，合肥雨黑豆。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year, black beans rained at Hefei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Kangxi 26 (1687), black beans rained at Hefei.

sentences.zh: 二十八年正月，含山雨小豆。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year, small beans rained at Hanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kangxi 28 (1689), small beans rained at Hanshan.

sentences.zh: 四十一年二月，湖南竹生實。

translations.literal: In the second month of the forty-first year, bamboo in Hunan bore fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Kangxi 41 (1702), bamboo in Hunan bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 四十四年三月，葭州雨黑豆。

translations.literal: In the third month of the forty-fourth year, black beans rained at Jiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Kangxi 44 (1705), black beans rained at Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 四十五年春，橫州竹生實。

translations.literal: In the spring of the forty-fifth year, bamboo at Hengzhou bore fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Kangxi 45 (1706), bamboo at Hengzhou bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 六十年夏，安化天雨蕎麥。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixtieth year, buckwheat rained from the sky at Anhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Kangxi 60 (1721), buckwheat rained from the sky at Anhua.

sentences.zh: 六十一年正月，大埔竹結實。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixty-first year, bamboo at Dabu set fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kangxi 61 (1722), bamboo at Dabu set fruit.

sentences.zh: 十一月，岑溪枯竹開花。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, withered bamboo at Cenxi blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, withered bamboo at Cenxi blossomed.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年五月，鍾祥竹開花。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of Yongzheng 5 (1727), bamboo at Zhongxiang blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongzheng 5 (1727), bamboo at Zhongxiang blossomed.

sentences.zh: 十月，當塗雨紅綠豆，形如小麥，無蒂。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, red and green beans rained at Dangtu, shaped like wheat but without stems.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, red and green beans rained at Dangtu, shaped like wheat but without stems.

sentences.zh: 十年，什邡縣雨蕎麥。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, buckwheat rained at Shifang County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 10 (1732), buckwheat rained at Shifang County.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，山陽、清河雨黑豆，啖之味苦。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year, black beans rained at Shanyang and Qinghe; eaten, they tasted bitter.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongzheng 11 (1733), black beans rained at Shanyang and Qinghe, and those who ate them found the taste bitter.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，宜昌竹結實，民采食之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year, bamboo at Yichang set fruit, and the people gathered and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yongzheng 12 (1734), bamboo at Yichang set fruit, and the people gathered and ate them.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月，夷陵竹生實如麥，民競采食之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, bamboo at Yiling bore fruit like wheat, and the people vied to gather and eat them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Yongzheng 13 (1735), bamboo at Yiling bore fruit like wheat, and the people vied to gather and eat them.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年二月，昌化雨豆。

translations.literal: In the second month of Qianlong 2 (1737), beans rained at Changhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Qianlong 2 (1737), beans rained at Changhua.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，成縣竹生實。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixth year, bamboo at Cheng County bore fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Qianlong 6 (1741), bamboo at Cheng County bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 十八年九月，陽春竹皆結實枯死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighteenth year, all bamboo at Yangchun set fruit and withered dead.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Qianlong 18 (1753), all bamboo at Yangchun set fruit and withered dead.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，永嘉東山竹結實如麥。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-second year, bamboo on East Mountain at Yongjia set fruit like wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Qianlong 22 (1757), bamboo on East Mountain at Yongjia set fruit like wheat.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，池州雨豆。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, beans rained at Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23 (1758), beans rained at Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，安化雨蕎麥，形似而小。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, buckwheat rained at Anhua, resembling buckwheat but smaller.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26 (1761), buckwheat rained at Anhua, resembling buckwheat but smaller.

sentences.zh: 四十一年六月，餘姚雨小麥、黃豆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the forty-first year, wheat and yellow soybeans rained at Yuyao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Qianlong 41 (1776), wheat and yellow soybeans rained at Yuyao.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十二年春，黃陂雨豆。

translations.literal: In the spring of Jiaqing 12 (1807), beans rained at Huangpi.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 12 (1807), beans rained at Huangpi.

sentences.zh: 道光二年夏，黃岩天雨菽。

translations.literal: In the summer of Daoguang 2 (1822), legumes rained from the sky at Huangyan.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Daoguang 2 (1822), legumes rained from the sky at Huangyan.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，黃梅雨豆麥穀米。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, beans, wheat, grain, and rice rained at Huangmei.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Daoguang 4 (1824), beans, wheat, grain, and rice rained at Huangmei.

sentences.zh: 十六年十二月，武寧雨豆。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year, beans rained at Wuning.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Daoguang 16 (1836), beans rained at Wuning.

sentences.zh: 二十年十一月，鍾祥竹開花。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twentieth year, bamboo at Zhongxiang blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Daoguang 20 (1840), bamboo at Zhongxiang blossomed.

sentences.zh: 二十五年七月，竹生米，可食。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, seventh month, bamboo bore rice that could be eaten.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Daoguang 25 (1845), bamboo bore rice grains fit to eat.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年六月，孝義廳山竹結實，人采食；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Xianfeng 1 (1851), bamboo on South Mountain at Xiaoyi Subprefecture set fruit, and people gathered and ate them;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Xianfeng 1 (1851), bamboo on South Mountain at Xiaoyi Subprefecture set fruit, and people gathered and ate them;

sentences.zh: 青浦竹生花。

translations.literal: bamboo at Qingpu bore flowers.
translations.idiomatic: bamboo at Qingpu bore flowers.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月，太平雨豆。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year, beans rained at Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Xianfeng 2 (1852), beans rained at Taiping.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，隨州天雨豆。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, beans rained from the sky at Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Xianfeng 4 (1854), beans rained from the sky at Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 四月，黃岡雨黑豆，食之味苦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, black beans rained at Huanggang; eaten, they tasted bitter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, black beans rained at Huanggang, and those who ate them found the taste bitter.

sentences.zh: 冬，武昌縣雨黑豆。

translations.literal: In winter, black beans rained at Wuchang County.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, black beans rained at Wuchang County.

sentences.zh: 五年正月初三日，孝感天雨小豆。

translations.literal: On the third day of the first month of the fifth year, small beans rained from the sky at Xiaogan.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day of the first month of Xianfeng 5 (1855), small beans rained from the sky at Xiaogan.

sentences.zh: 二月，又雨豆。

translations.literal: In the second month, beans rained again.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, beans rained again.

sentences.zh: 三月，武昌天雨黑豆，如槐實；

translations.literal: In the third month, black beans rained from the sky at Wuchang, like locust-tree pods;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, black beans rained from the sky at Wuchang, shaped like locust-tree pods;

sentences.zh: 黃安雨豆。

translations.literal: beans rained at Huang'an.
translations.idiomatic: beans rained at Huang'an.

sentences.zh: 夏，黃州、蘄水雨豆，如槐實。

translations.literal: In summer, beans rained at Huangzhou and Qishui, like locust-tree pods.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, beans rained at Huangzhou and Qishui, shaped like locust-tree pods.

sentences.zh: 十一月，黃岡天雨豆，如槐實；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, beans rained from the sky at Huanggang, like locust-tree pods;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, beans rained from the sky at Huanggang, shaped like locust-tree pods;

sentences.zh: 歸州竹結實，人采食之。

translations.literal: bamboo at Guizhou set fruit, and people gathered and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: bamboo at Guizhou set fruit, and people gathered and ate them.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，隨州雨豆。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year, beans rained at Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Xianfeng 6 (1856), beans rained at Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，興國雨豆，色赤。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, beans rained at Xingguo, red in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Xianfeng 8 (1858), red beans rained at Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 秋，興山竹結實。

translations.literal: In autumn, bamboo at Xingshan set fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, bamboo at Xingshan set fruit.

sentences.zh: 九年春，麻城民間番瓜成人形。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year, pumpkins among the people at Macheng took human shape.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Xianfeng 9 (1859), pumpkins among the people at Macheng took human shape.

sentences.zh: 十年，龍泉雨豆，色赤。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, beans rained at Longquan, red in color.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 (1860), red beans rained at Longquan.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月，麻城雨豆。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year, beans rained at Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Xianfeng 11 (1861), beans rained at Macheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月，溪梁雨豆，色赤。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, beans rained at Xiliang, red in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, red beans rained at Xiliang.

sentences.zh: 同治元年八月，西寧丹噶爾廳竹開紅花；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of Tongzhi 1 (1862), bamboo at the Danggar Subprefecture in Xining bore red flowers;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Tongzhi 1 (1862), bamboo at the Danggar Subprefecture in Xining bore red flowers;

sentences.zh: 灤州瓜窳剖之有血，食者立病。

translations.literal: melons at Luanzhou, when cut open, contained blood, and those who ate them fell ill at once.
translations.idiomatic: melons at Luanzhou, when cut open, bled; those who ate them fell ill immediately.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，永豐天雨豆，五色斑爛。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, beans rained from the sky at Yongfeng, brilliantly colored in five hues.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tongzhi 3 (1864), beans rained from the sky at Yongfeng in five brilliant colors.

sentences.zh: 三月，景寧、嵊縣雨豆。

translations.literal: In the third month, beans rained at Jingning and Sheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, beans rained at Jingning and Sheng County.

sentences.zh: 五月，京山縣雨豆，其色黑光。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, beans rained at Jingshan County, black and lustrous.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, beans rained at Jingshan County, black and lustrous.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，棲霞雨草子如蕎麥。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, grass seeds like buckwheat rained at Qixia.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongzhi 6 (1867), grass seeds resembling buckwheat rained at Qixia.

sentences.zh: 夏，嵊縣雨豆。

translations.literal: In summer, beans rained at Sheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, beans rained at Sheng County.

sentences.zh: 七年，槁城生豆如人麵，五官俱備。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, at Gaocheng beans grew like human faces, with all five features complete.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7 (1868), at Gaocheng beans grew shaped like human faces, with all five features complete.

sentences.zh: 九年十月，遂昌雨穀，外黑內紅；

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the ninth year, grain rained at Suichang, black outside and red within;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Tongzhi 9 (1870), grain rained at Suichang, black on the outside and red within;

sentences.zh: 德興雨豆，內黑外白。

translations.literal: beans rained at Dexing, black within and white without.

sentences.zh: 十一月，孔子文廟災。

translations.literal: in the eleventh month, disaster at the Confucian Temple.
translations.idiomatic: in the eleventh month, fire destroyed the Confucian Temple.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年正月初四日，皋蘭縣災，延燒官舍六十餘間。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the first month of Xuantong 1, disaster in Gaolan County spread and burned more than sixty government buildings.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the first month of Xuantong 1 (1909), fire in Gaolan County spread and burned more than sixty government buildings.

sentences.zh: 二月二十六日，蘭州省城院門南街大火，延燒房屋二百零九間。

translations.literal: On the twenty-sixth day of the second month, a great fire on South Street at Yuanmen in Lanzhou provincial city spread and burned two hundred and nine buildings.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-sixth day of the second month, a great fire on South Street at Yuanmen in Lanzhou provincial city spread and burned two hundred and nine buildings.

sentences.zh: 順治十年二月，曹縣夜間火光遍野。

translations.literal: In the second month of Shunzhi 10, at night in Caoxian firelight filled the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 10 (1653), firelight filled the countryside around Caoxian at night.

sentences.zh: 五月，渭南四野火災，見持炬人三尺許，眾繞火際，次日焚處拾一折簡，字數行，如人書，其語曰：「土地不寧，天降凶神三位，一收牛，一收馬，一收人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, fire disaster in the four fields around Weinan; a torch-bearer about three chi tall was seen, and the crowd circled the edge of the flames. The next day at the burned place a folded slip was picked up with several lines of characters like human writing; its words said: "The land is unsettled; Heaven sends down three fierce spirits, one to take cattle, one to take horses, one to take people."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, fire swept the countryside around Weinan, and a torch-bearer about three chi tall was seen as people circled the edge of the flames. The next day at the burned site a folded slip was found with several lines written like a human hand; it read, "The land is unsettled; Heaven sends down three fierce spirits, one to take cattle, one to take horses, one to take people."

sentences.zh: 」十四年十月二十七日，清豐空中起火，燒民房數百間。

translations.literal: " On the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month of the fourteenth year, fire broke out in the sky at Qingfeng and burned several hundred private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: " On the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month of Shunzhi 14 (1657), fire broke out in the sky at Qingfeng and burned several hundred private dwellings.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年三月，縉雲曉見黧麵人從空中放火，捕之不見。

translations.literal: In the third month of Kangxi 12, at dawn in Jinyun a dark-faced man was seen setting fires from the sky; when pursued, he could not be seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Kangxi 12 (1673), at dawn in Jinyun a dark-faced man was seen setting fires from the sky; when pursued, he vanished.

sentences.zh: 五月，寧波仙鎮廟井中有火光上騰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, in the well at Xianzhen Temple in Ningbo firelight rose upward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, firelight rose from the well at Xianzhen Temple in Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月十五日，海豐火光遍野。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month of the fourteenth year, firelight filled the countryside at Haifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month of Kangxi 14 (1675), firelight filled the countryside at Haifeng.

sentences.zh: 二十五年二月，兩廣總督衙門兩旗竿忽白晝飛火，焚其右，焦灼過半。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fifth year, at the yamen of the Governor-General of the Two Guangs the two flagpoles suddenly emitted flying fire in broad daylight; the right one was burned, and more than half was charred.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Kangxi 25 (1686), at the yamen of the Governor-General of the Two Guangs the two flagpoles suddenly emitted flying fire in broad daylight; the right one was burned, and more than half was charred.

sentences.zh: 三十一年秋，南樂空中有火，著鐵皆明，自申至亥乃止。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the thirty-first year, fire in the sky at Nanle made all iron it touched bright; from the shen hour to the hai hour it then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Kangxi 31 (1692), fire in the sky at Nanle made all iron it touched glow; from the shen hour to the hai hour it then ceased.

sentences.zh: 五十年二月丙寅，東平烈風中有火光。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the second month of the fiftieth year, in a violent wind at Dongping there was firelight.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the second month of Kangxi 50 (1711), firelight appeared in a violent wind at Dongping.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年四月二十九日，岐山有火光，自西而東。

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month of Qianlong 17, at Qishan there was firelight moving from west to east.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month of Qianlong 17 (1752), firelight at Qishan moved from west to east.

sentences.zh: 七月，芮城有火光如電。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, at Ruicheng there was firelight like lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, at Ruicheng there was firelight like lightning.

sentences.zh: 二十年十一月，彭澤江心洲有穴出火，投葦輒燃，久而不息。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twentieth year, on a mid-river islet at Pengze a hole emitted fire; reeds thrown in immediately ignited, and for a long time it did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Qianlong 20 (1755), on a mid-river islet at Pengze a hole emitted fire; reeds thrown in immediately ignited, and burned for a long time without ceasing.

sentences.zh: 二十二年二月二日，高平有火球大如鬥，其色黃紅綠相間，就地行走，不知所終。

translations.literal: On the second day of the second month of the twenty-second year, at Gaoping there was a fireball as large as a dou, its color alternating yellow, red, and green; it walked along the ground, and no one knew where it ended.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the second month of Qianlong 22 (1757), at Gaoping a fireball as large as a dou appeared, its color alternating yellow, red, and green; it moved along the ground, and no one knew where it went.

sentences.zh: 二十七年九月，臨縣空中有火光大如鬥，墜城南隅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-seventh year, in the sky over Lin County there was firelight as large as a dou; it fell in the southeastern corner of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Qianlong 27 (1762), firelight as large as a dou appeared in the sky over Lin County and fell in the southeastern corner of the city.

sentences.zh: 三十三年三月，即墨日夕有火球經天。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirty-third year, at Jimo from dusk to nightfall fireballs crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Qianlong 33 (1768), at Jimo fireballs crossed the sky from dusk to nightfall.

sentences.zh: 五十年冬，棗陽有火球如鬥，飛半裏外。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fiftieth year, at Zaoyang there was a fireball like a dou that flew more than half a li away.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Qianlong 50 (1785), at Zaoyang a fireball like a dou flew more than half a li away.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶九年二月十二日，滕縣城東石溝見火球飛落。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day of the second month of Jiaqing 9, at Shigou east of Teng County city a fireball was seen flying down.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the second month of Jiaqing 9 (1804), a fireball was seen flying down at Shigou east of Teng County city.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月，黃安有火大如球，自東而西，落於泮池。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, at Huang'an there was fire as large as a ball; from east to west it fell into the school pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Jiaqing 12 (1807), at Huang'an a ball of fire moved from east to west and fell into the school pool.

sentences.zh: 十六年夏，撫寧夜遍地起火。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixteenth year, at night in Funing fires broke out everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jiaqing 16 (1811), fires broke out everywhere around Funing at night.

sentences.zh: 道光三年三月，蘄州、清江水中出火。

translations.literal: In the third month of Daoguang 3, fire emerged from the water at Qizhou and Qingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Daoguang 3 (1823), fire emerged from the water at Qizhou and Qingjiang.

sentences.zh: 二十年五月，均州夜見火光。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twentieth year, at night at Junzhou firelight was seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Daoguang 20 (1840), firelight was seen at night at Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十二年十一月，鄖西地中出火。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twenty-second year, fire emerged from the ground at Yunxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Daoguang 22 (1842), fire emerged from the ground at Yunxi.

sentences.zh: 二十四年七月，光化遍地綠火。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-fourth year, green fire filled the ground at Guanghua.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Daoguang 24 (1844), green fire filled the ground at Guanghua.

sentences.zh: 二十六年正月，平鄉火光遍野。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-sixth year, firelight filled the countryside at Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Daoguang 26 (1846), firelight filled the countryside at Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年八月二十八日，隨州有天火自西南流東北，其光觸地，有聲如鼓。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month of Xianfeng 1, at Suizhou heaven-fire flowed from the southwest toward the northeast; its light touched the ground, and there was a sound like drums.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month of Xianfeng 1 (1851), at Suizhou heaven-fire flowed from the southwest toward the northeast; its light touched the ground, and a sound like drums was heard.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，通州有火如星如燐，以千百計，自西南趨東北，凡四五夜始熄。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, at Tongzhou there was fire like stars and like will-o'-the-wisps, numbering in the thousands; from the southwest they rushed toward the northeast, and only after four or five nights did they cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xianfeng 3 (1853), at Tongzhou fires like stars and will-o'-the-wisps numbered in the thousands; rushing from the southwest toward the northeast, they burned for four or five nights before ceasing.

sentences.zh: 十年冬，肥城既昏，有火從地中起，如燐而火，色赤而青，作二流光，遍地皆燃。

translations.literal: In the winter of the tenth year, at Feicheng after dusk fire rose from the ground like will-o'-the-wisps yet like flame, its color red and blue, forming two streams of light; everywhere it touched burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Xianfeng 10 (1860), at Feicheng after dusk fire rose from the ground like will-o'-the-wisps yet like flame, red and blue in color, forming two streams of light; everywhere it touched burned.

sentences.zh: 同治二年九月，曲陽有火球自西南飛向東北，或散四方，或聚為一，其象無常。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Tongzhi 2, at Quyang a fireball flew from the southwest toward the northeast; sometimes it scattered in the four directions, sometimes it gathered into one—its form was inconstant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Tongzhi 2 (1863), at Quyang a fireball flew from the southwest toward the northeast; sometimes it scattered in all directions, sometimes it gathered into one—its form was inconstant.

sentences.zh: 四年，通渭、泰安火光西現如隕星。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, at Tongwei and Tai'an firelight appeared in the west like a falling star.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 (1865), at Tongwei and Tai'an firelight appeared in the west like a falling star.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年正月十四日，灤州五聖祠突有火光，俄而火起高矗雲霄，祠竟無恙。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day of the first month of Guangxu 1, at the Temple of the Five Sages in Luanzhou firelight suddenly appeared; presently fire rose towering into the clouds, yet the temple was unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day of the first month of Guangxu 1 (1875), at the Temple of the Five Sages in Luanzhou firelight suddenly appeared; presently flames rose towering into the clouds, yet the temple was unharmed.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，玉田見火球飛向東北，其聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year, at Yutian a fireball was seen flying toward the northeast; its sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Guangxu 5 (1879), at Yutian a fireball was seen flying toward the northeast with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 二十二年四月戊子，南樂有火光徑尺，明如月，自西南往東北，尾長丈許，忽炸為火星四散。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the fourth month of the twenty-second year, at Nanle there was firelight a foot in diameter, bright as the moon; from the southwest toward the northeast it went, its tail about a zhang long, then suddenly exploded into sparks scattering in the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the fourth month of Guangxu 22 (1896), at Nanle firelight a foot in diameter, bright as the moon, moved from the southwest toward the northeast with a tail about a zhang long, then suddenly exploded into sparks scattering in all directions.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月戊午夕，南樂有火光，圓可徑尺，飛向西南。

translations.literal: On the evening of the wuwu day of the fifth month of the twenty-third year, at Nanle there was firelight, round and about a foot in diameter, flying toward the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of the wuwu day of the fifth month of Guangxu 23 (1897), at Nanle round firelight about a foot in diameter flew toward the southwest.

sentences.zh: 二十五年十一月乙未夜，南樂有火光流空中，其明如月。

translations.literal: On the night of the yiwei day of the eleventh month of the twenty-fifth year, at Nanle firelight flowed through the sky, its brightness like the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the yiwei day of the eleventh month of Guangxu 25 (1899), at Nanle firelight flowed through the sky, bright as the moon.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月壬戌夜，南樂有火光流空中。

translations.literal: On the night of the renxu day of the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year, at Nanle firelight flowed through the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the renxu day of the seventh month of Guangxu 26 (1900), at Nanle firelight flowed through the sky.

sentences.zh: 順治三年六月初四日，鎮洋新安鎮李明家地出血。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the sixth month of Shunzhi 3, blood issued from the ground at the home of Li Ming in Xin'an Town, Zhenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the sixth month of Shunzhi 3 (1646), blood issued from the ground at the home of Li Ming in Xin'an Town, Zhenyang.

sentences.zh: 初五日，俞二家地出血尤甚。

translations.literal: On the fifth day, blood issued from the ground at the home of Yu Er even more severely.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day, blood issued even more copiously from the ground at the home of Yu Er.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，嘉定見赤氣互東方。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifth year, at Jiading red vapor was seen stretching across the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Shunzhi 5 (1648), red vapor was seen stretching across the eastern sky at Jiading.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，鶴王鎮鄉民見血從地湧出。

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year, villagers at Hewang Town saw blood gush from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Shunzhi 7 (1650), villagers at Hewang Town saw blood gush from the ground.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，東昌有赤光，聲如水鴨，往東南而沒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, at Dongchang there was red light with a sound like water ducks; it went toward the southeast and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Shunzhi 9 (1652), at Dongchang red light appeared with a sound like water ducks; it moved toward the southeast and vanished.

sentences.zh: 十六年，永年南關外地中湧血，嘶嘶有聲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, outside the South Pass of Yongnian blood gushed from the ground with a hissing sound.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659), outside the South Pass of Yongnian blood gushed from the ground with a hissing sound.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年四月，萊陽地湧血丈餘，氣腥，久不敢近。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Kangxi 14, at Laiyang blood gushed from the ground more than a zhang high; the odor was foul, and for a long time no one dared approach.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 14 (1675), blood gushed more than a zhang high from the ground at Laiyang; the odor was foul, and for a long time no one dared approach.

sentences.zh: 五十九年七月十六日，榮成、萊陽有赤氣自東而起，倏如匹練，互向西北去，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month of the fifty-ninth year, at Rongcheng and Laiyang red vapor rose from the east, suddenly like a bolt of silk stretching toward the northwest; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month of Kangxi 59 (1720), red vapor rose from the east at Rongcheng and Laiyang, suddenly like a bolt of silk stretching toward the northwest, with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年十二月二十八日夜分，福山見紅光滿野。

translations.literal: At midnight on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month of Yongzheng 7, at Fushan red light filled the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month of Yongzheng 7 (1729), red light filled the countryside at Fushan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十五年七月二十八日，肥城有赤光自北方起，夜半漸退；

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month of Qianlong 35, at Feicheng red light rose from the north and gradually receded at midnight;
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month of Qianlong 35 (1770), red light rose from the north at Feicheng and gradually receded at midnight;

sentences.zh: 長山西北見赤氣彌天，中有白氣如縷間之，四更後始散。

translations.literal: northwest of Changshan red vapor filled the sky, with white vapor like threads interwoven among it; only after the fourth watch did it disperse.
translations.idiomatic: northwest of Changshan red vapor filled the sky, with white vapor like threads interwoven among it; only after the fourth watch did it disperse.

sentences.zh: 二十九日夜，榮成夜見紅光燭天；

translations.literal: on the night of the twenty-ninth day, at Rongcheng red light at night illuminated the sky;
translations.idiomatic: on the night of the twenty-ninth day, at Rongcheng red light illuminated the sky;

sentences.zh: 東光有氣如火，橫蔽西北，互數十丈，中含紅光，森如劍戟上射。

translations.literal: at Dongguang there was vapor like fire stretching across the northwest for several dozen zhang; within it was red light, dense as sword and halberd blades shooting upward.
translations.idiomatic: at Dongguang vapor like fire stretched across the northwest for several dozen zhang; within it red light rose dense as sword and halberd blades shooting upward.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶九年正月，曆城天雨血。

translations.literal: In the first month of Jiaqing 9, blood rained from the sky at Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jiaqing 9 (1804), blood rained from the sky at Licheng.

sentences.zh: 道光十一年冬，太平雨血，著人衣皆赤。

translations.literal: In the winter of Daoguang 11, blood rained at Taiping; whatever touched people's clothing turned red.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Daoguang 11 (1831), blood rained at Taiping; whatever touched people's clothing turned red.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月二十八日，嵊縣有赤光如球，高數丈，三日乃滅。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month of the seventeenth year, at Sheng County there was red light like a ball, several zhang high; after three days it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month of Daoguang 17 (1837), at Sheng County red light like a ball rose several zhang high; after three days it ceased.

sentences.zh: 二十八年正月，鬆滋天雨血，以碗盛之，作桃花色。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year, blood rained from the sky at Songzi; when collected in a bowl, it was the color of peach blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Daoguang 28 (1848), blood rained from the sky at Songzi; when collected in a bowl, it was the color of peach blossoms.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年正月十四日，西鄉雨血如注。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day of the first month of Xianfeng 3, blood rained in torrents at Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day of the first month of Xianfeng 3 (1853), blood rained in torrents at Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，曹縣東方有赤氣如旗杆形。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year, east of Caoxian there was red vapor shaped like a flagpole.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Xianfeng 5 (1855), east of Caoxian red vapor shaped like a flagpole appeared.

sentences.zh: 六年七月，武進地出血。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, blood issued from the ground at Wujin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Xianfeng 6 (1856), blood issued from the ground at Wujin.

sentences.zh: 同治五年秋，崇陽雨血。

translations.literal: In the autumn of Tongzhi 5, blood rained at Chongyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Tongzhi 5 (1866), blood rained at Chongyang.

sentences.zh: 七年正月二十日，光化雨血。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of the first month of the seventh year, blood rained at Guanghua.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth day of the first month of Tongzhi 7 (1868), blood rained at Guanghua.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年二月初四日，曹縣見紅光自天降於八里灣水中。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the second month of Guangxu 2, at Caoxian red light was seen descending from the sky into the water at Bali Bay.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the second month of Guangxu 2 (1876), at Caoxian red light was seen descending from the sky into the water at Bali Bay.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，襄陽雨血。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year, blood rained at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Guangxu 7 (1881), blood rained at Xiangyang.
